iFold

Made for the joy of it.

An independent app for Mac.

A LITTLE HEADS-UP

Meet your Mac’s
softer side.

iFold is currently a source-build app. This preview doesn’t include a public installer.

What you’ll need

  • macOS Sonoma 14 or later.
  • An Apple silicon MacBook with a lid-angle sensor. The project lists M2 Air and later, and 14-inch / 16-inch Pro models.
  • Screen Recording permission to bend your live desktop.

The app processes frames on your Mac. Nothing is recorded to disk or uploaded.

Already have the project?

In the iFold project folder, run:

./build.sh --run

Grant Screen Recording permission when prompted, then relaunch iFold.
